title: Gone with the Wind
source: Box Office Mojo, Gone with the Wind (1939) release summary, Wayback Machine capture of 1 Aug 2018
notes: The 12/15/1939 release row: $189,523,031. It covers every run before the 1989 re-issue, the next release the summary lists ($2,403,316; then the 1998 re-issue, $6,750,112). Lifetime gross on the page: $198,676,459.

title: Star Wars
source: Box Office Mojo, Star Wars (1977) release summary, Wayback Machine capture of 9 Oct 2018
notes: The 05/25/1977 release row: $307,263,857. It covers every run before the 08/13/1982 re-issue, the next release the summary lists ($15,476,285, which the weekly charts carry; then the 1997 Special Edition, $138,257,865). Lifetime gross on the page: $460,998,007.
